items.title: PolyAI Dialog-RSN-1 is now on Amazon SageMaker JumpStart
items.summary: PolyAI Dialog-RSN-1, a reasoning model built for real-time complex dialog, is available today on AWS Marketplace and Amazon SageMaker JumpStart. Discover it, evaluate it on your own data, and deploy it to a secure SageMaker endpoint in your own AWS account.
items.creator: Helen Greul
